frontmatter.name: commit
frontmatter.description: 'Generate a Japanese commit message with Conventional Commits prefix and create one or more atomic commits. Use whenever a commit needs to be made in this repository — both when the user explicitly invokes /commit AND whenever an AI agent commits autonomously as part of the issue-mr-flow (flow-id 6/12/18/22). All commits in this repo MUST go through this skill; direct git commit is blocked by a PreToolUse hook. Flow: git status → confirm with user via AskUserQuestion → filter sensitive/junk files → dev-tools/src/create-commit.sh (NO Claude footer)'
frontmatter.title: git commit標準化
